priority_1_licensing_clarity.name: AG News: News Topic Classification Benchmark
priority_1_licensing_clarity.notes: The exact 4-class topic classification benchmark (120,000 train, 7,600 test articles) was constructed by Xiang Zhang, Junbo Zhao, and Yann LeCun (NeurIPS 2015) and distributed in CSV format without an explicit dataset license. It was derived from Antonio Gulli's AG corpus of news articles, which was collected by the ComeToMyHead academic engine and made available with non-commercial research terms and redistribution limitations. Underlying news text remains copyrighted by source news organizations. Because the specific 4-class benchmark distribution does not carry an explicit dataset license, its status is unspecified by source and commercial usability remains unknown.
